section.content: 本发明提供一种机器学习装置及机器学习系统，在更换了车辆部件的情况下，抑制在车辆中使用的机器学习模型的推定精度降低的情况。机器学习装置具备：推定部(51)，使用机器学习模型来推定规定的信息；更新部(52)，对机器学习模型进行更新；及部件信息取得部(53)，检测车辆部件的更换，并且取得更换后的车辆部件的识别信息。更新部在与机器学习模型的输入数据相关的车辆部件被更换为不同的结构的车辆部件的情况下，从服务器(2)接收使用与更换后的车辆部件对应的训练数据集进行学习所得的新的机器学习模型，并将新的机器学习模型应用于车辆。

The invention provides a machine learning device and a machine learning system, which can restrain the situation that the estimation precision of a machine learning model used in a vehicle is reduced when a vehicle component is replaced. The machine learning device is provided with: an estimation unit (51) that estimates predetermined information using a machine learning model; an update unit (52) that updates the machine learning model; and a component information acquisition unit (53) that detects replacement of the vehicle component and acquires identification information of the vehicle component after replacement. When a vehicle component relating to input data of a machine learning model is replaced with a vehicle component of a different configuration, an update unit receives a new machine learning model learned by using a training data set corresponding to the replaced vehicle component from a server (2), and applies the new machine learning model to the vehicle.

Machine learning device and machine learning systemTechnical Field

The present invention relates to a machine learning device and a machine learning system.

Background

In recent years, with the development of AI (artificial intelligence) technology, control using a machine learning model such as a neural network model is being studied in a vehicle. For example, in the machine learning system described in patent document 1, the temperature of an exhaust gas purification catalyst provided in an internal combustion engine is estimated using a neural network model.

In order to improve the estimation accuracy of such a neural network model, it is necessary to learn the neural network model in advance. For example, as described in patent document 1, a neural network model is learned in a server, and the learned neural network model is transmitted from the server to a vehicle.

Documents of the prior art

Patent document

Patent document 1: japanese patent laid-open publication No. 2019-183698

Disclosure of Invention

Problems to be solved by the invention

However, when deterioration or failure of vehicle components occurs with use of the vehicle, replacement of the vehicle components is performed. Further, in some cases, replacement of vehicle components is performed in order to mount higher-performance vehicle components on the vehicle.

However, machine learning models used in vehicles are typically matched to the characteristics of the vehicle components prior to replacement. Therefore, when the characteristics of the vehicle component change due to the replacement of the vehicle component, the estimation accuracy of the machine learning model may be reduced.

In view of the above problems, an object of the present invention is to suppress a decrease in estimation accuracy of a machine learning model used in a vehicle when a vehicle component is replaced.

Means for solving the problems

The gist of the present disclosure is as follows.

(1) A machine learning device provided in a vehicle, the machine learning device comprising: an estimation unit that estimates predetermined information using a machine learning model; an updating unit that updates the machine learning model; and a component information acquisition unit configured to detect replacement of a vehicle component and acquire identification information of the vehicle component after the replacement, wherein the update unit receives a new machine learning model learned by using a training data set corresponding to the vehicle component after the replacement from a server and applies the new machine learning model to the vehicle, when the vehicle component related to the input data of the machine learning model is replaced with a vehicle component having a different configuration.

(2) The machine learning device according to the above (1), wherein the update unit transmits the identification information of the vehicle component after the replacement and the identification information of the vehicle to the server, and the new machine learning model is a machine learning model corresponding to the identification information of the vehicle.

(3) The machine learning apparatus according to (1) or (2) above, wherein the machine learning model is a neural network model.

(4) A machine learning system is provided with a server and a vehicle, wherein the server is provided with: a first communication device capable of communicating with the vehicle; and a control device, the vehicle including: a second communication device capable of communicating with the server; an estimation unit that estimates predetermined information using a machine learning model; an updating unit that updates the machine learning model; and a component information acquisition unit that detects replacement of a vehicle component and acquires identification information of the vehicle component after the replacement, wherein the update unit transmits the identification information of the vehicle component after the replacement to the server when the vehicle component related to the input data of the machine learning model is replaced with a vehicle component having a different configuration, the control device transmits a new machine learning model, which is learned using a training data set corresponding to the vehicle component after the replacement, to the vehicle, and the update unit applies the new machine learning model to the vehicle.

Effects of the invention

According to the present invention, when a vehicle component is replaced, it is possible to suppress a decrease in estimation accuracy of a machine learning model used in a vehicle.

Detailed Description

Hereinafter, embodiments of the present invention will be described in detail with reference to the drawings. Fig. 1 is a schematic configuration diagram of a machine learning system 1 according to an embodiment of the present invention. The machine learning system 1 includes a server 2 and a vehicle 3.

As shown in fig. 1, the server 2 is provided outside the vehicle 3, and includes a communication interface 21, a storage device 22, a memory 23, and a processor 24. The server 2 may further include an input device such as a keyboard and a mouse, an output device such as a display, and the like. The server 2 may be configured by a plurality of computers.

The communication interface 21 can communicate with the vehicle 3, and can communicate the server 2 with the vehicle 3. Specifically, the communication interface 21 has an interface circuit for connecting the server 2 with the communication network 5. The server 2 communicates with the vehicle 3 via the communication interface 21, the communication network 5, and the wireless base station 6. The communication interface 21 is an example of a communication device.

The storage device 22 includes, for example, a Hard Disk Drive (HDD), a Solid State Drive (SSD), an optical recording medium, and the like. The storage device 22 stores various data, for example, a computer program or the like for causing the processor 24 to execute various processes.

The memory 23 includes a semiconductor memory such as a Random Access Memory (RAM). The memory 23 stores various data and the like used when various processes are executed by the processor 24, for example.

The communication interface 21, the storage device 22, and the memory 23 are connected to the processor 24 via signal lines. The processor 24 has one or more CPUs and peripheral circuits thereof, and executes various processes. The processor 24 may further include an arithmetic circuit such as a logical operation unit or a numerical operation unit. The processor 24 is an example of a control device.

Fig. 2 is a diagram schematically showing a part of the structure of the vehicle 3 in fig. 1. As shown in fig. 2, the vehicle 3 includes an actuator 31, a sensor 32, a communication module 33, and an electronic Control unit (ecu) 40. That is, the actuator 31, the sensor 32, the communication module 33, and the ECU40 are mounted on the vehicle 3. The actuator 31, the sensor 32, and the communication module 33 are connected to the ECU40 so as to be able to communicate with each other via an in-vehicle Network conforming to a CAN (Controller Area Network) standard or the like.

The actuator 31 is an operating member required for running of the vehicle 3, and includes, for example, a member (an ignition plug, a fuel injection valve, a throttle valve driving actuator, an EGR control valve, and the like), a motor, a clutch, and the like required for operation of the internal combustion engine. The ECU40 controls the actuator 31.

The sensors 32 detect state quantities of the vehicle 3, the internal combustion engine, the battery, and the like, and include a vehicle speed sensor, a GPS receiver, an accelerator opening degree sensor, an air flow meter, an air-fuel ratio sensor, a crank angle sensor, a torque sensor, a voltage sensor, a temperature sensor, and the like. The output of the sensor 32 is sent to the ECU 40.

The actuator 31 and the sensor 32 constitute a vehicle component that is a component mounted on the vehicle 3. In other words, the vehicle components include the actuator 31 and the sensor 32.

The communication module 33 is a device that enables the vehicle 3 to communicate with the outside of the vehicle 3. The communication module 33 is, for example, a data communication module (dcm) capable of communicating with the communication network 5 via the wireless base station 6. In addition, as the communication module 33, a mobile terminal (for example, a smartphone, a tablet terminal, a WiFi router, or the like) may also be used. The communication module 33 is an example of a communication device.

The ECU40 includes the communication interface 41, the memory 42, and the processor 43, and executes various controls of the vehicle 3. In the present embodiment, one ECU40 is provided, but a plurality of ECUs may be provided for each function.

The communication interface 41 has an interface circuit for connecting the ECU40 to an in-vehicle network conforming to the CAN or the like standard. The ECU40 communicates with other in-vehicle devices as described above via the communication interface 41.

The memory 42 has, for example, a volatile semiconductor memory (e.g., RAM) and a nonvolatile semiconductor memory (e.g., ROM). The memory 42 stores a program executed in the processor 43, various data used when various processes are executed by the processor 43, and the like.

The processor 43 has one or more CPUs (Central Processing units) and peripheral circuits thereof, and performs various processes. The processor 43 may further include an arithmetic circuit such as a logical operation unit or a numerical operation unit. The communication interface 41, the memory 42, and the processor 43 are connected to each other via signal lines.

In the present embodiment, the ECU40 functions as a machine learning device. Fig. 3 is a functional block diagram of the ECU40 of fig. 2. The ECU40 includes the estimation unit 51, the update unit 52, and the component information acquisition unit 53. The estimation unit 51, the update unit 52, and the component information acquisition unit 53 are functional blocks that are realized by causing the processor 43 of the ECU40 to execute programs stored in the memory 42 of the ECU 40.

The estimation unit 51 estimates predetermined information using a machine learning model. The updating unit 52 updates the machine learning model used in the vehicle 3. In the present embodiment, a neural network model that outputs at least one output data (also referred to as a target variable) from a plurality of input data (also referred to as explanatory variables) is used as a machine learning model.

The neural network model used in the vehicle 3 is stored in the memory 42 of the ECU40 or other storage device provided in the vehicle 3. The estimation unit 51 inputs a plurality of values (input values) of input data to the neural network model to cause the neural network model to output at least one value (output value) of output data. At this time, as the value of each input data, for example, an output value of the sensor 32, a command value issued from the ECU40 to the actuator 31, a value acquired from the outside of the vehicle 3 via the communication module 33, a value calculated in the ECU40, and the like are used.

The estimation unit 51 estimates predetermined information corresponding to the value of the output data output from the neural network model. The predetermined information estimated by the estimation unit 51 is used for controlling the vehicle 3. In addition, the neural network model may be any one of a regression model and a classification model. When the neural network model is a regression model, the output data is, for example, the output torque Of the internal combustion engine, the concentration Of a predetermined component (HC, NOx, etc.) in the exhaust gas, the State Of Charge (SOC) Of the battery, and the like. On the other hand, when the neural network model is a classification model, the output data is, for example, an abnormality determination result of the predetermined sensor 32, a start determination result of an internal combustion engine in the hybrid vehicle, and the like. As the input data, a state quantity related to the output data is appropriately selected.

In order to improve the accuracy of such a neural network model, it is necessary to learn the neural network model in advance. Therefore, the neural network model is learned in, for example, a production plant of a vehicle.

In the learning of the neural network model, a training data set is used which is composed of a combination of actual measurement values of a plurality of input data and actual measurement values (correct answer data or teacher data) of at least one output data corresponding to the actual measurement values. The measured values of the input data and the output data are acquired, for example, using an engine mount, and a training data set is created by combining the corresponding measured values.

In the learning of the neural network model, a large number of training data sets are used, and parameters (weight w and deviation b) of the neural network model are repeatedly updated by a known error back propagation method so that a difference between a value of output data output from the neural network model and an actually measured value of the output data is small. As a result, the neural network model is learned, and a learned neural network model is generated. The generated learnt neural network model is mounted on ECU40 of vehicle 3 before vehicle 3 is shipped. That is, the information of the learned neural network model (the structure of the model, the weight w, the deviation b, and the like) is stored in the memory 42 of the ECU40 or in another storage device provided in the vehicle 3. The learned neural network model may be transmitted from the server 2 to the vehicle 3 after the vehicle 3 is shipped.

However, when deterioration or failure of a vehicle component such as the actuator 31 or the sensor 32 occurs along with use of the vehicle 3, replacement of the vehicle component is performed. Further, in some cases, replacement of vehicle components is performed in order to mount higher-performance vehicle components on the vehicle 3.

However, the neural network model installed to the ECU40 matches the characteristics of the vehicle components before replacement. Therefore, when the characteristics of the vehicle component change due to the replacement of the vehicle component, the estimation accuracy of the neural network model may be reduced.

Therefore, in the present embodiment, the component information acquisition unit 53 detects the replacement of the vehicle component, and acquires the identification information of the vehicle component after the replacement. When a vehicle component relating to input data of the neural network model is replaced with a vehicle component having a different configuration, the update unit 52 receives a new neural network model learned using a training data set corresponding to the replaced vehicle component from the server 2, and applies the new neural network model to the vehicle 3.

Specifically, when a vehicle component relating to input data of the neural network model is replaced with a vehicle component having a different configuration, the update unit 52 transmits identification information of the vehicle component after the replacement to the server 2. When receiving the identification information of the vehicle component after replacement from the vehicle 3, the processor 24 of the server 2 transmits to the vehicle 3 a new neural network model learned using the training data set corresponding to the vehicle component after replacement. Upon receiving the new neural network model from the server 2, the updating unit 52 applies the new neural network model to the vehicle 3.

As described above, by updating the neural network model in accordance with replacement of the vehicle component, it is possible to suppress a decrease in estimation accuracy of the neural network model used in the vehicle 3 when the vehicle component is replaced.

The control described above will be described in detail below with reference to flowcharts of fig. 5 and 6. Fig. 5 is a flowchart showing a control routine of the model update process. The present control routine is repeatedly executed by the ECU40 of the vehicle 3 at predetermined execution intervals.

First, in step S101, the component information acquiring unit 53 determines whether or not the replacement flag F is 1. The replacement flag F is set to 1 when a vehicle component is replaced, and the initial value of the replacement flag F is 0. If it is determined in step S101 that the replacement flag F is 0, the present control routine proceeds to step S102.

In step S102, the component information acquiring unit 53 determines whether or not the vehicle component related to the input data of the neural network model is replaced with a vehicle component having a different configuration. For example, in the case where the output values of the sensors 32 are used as input data of the neural network model, the sensors 32 correspond to vehicle components related to the input data of the neural network model. In addition, when the command value issued from the ECU40 to the actuator 31 is used as input data of the neural network model, the actuator 31 corresponds to a vehicle component relating to the input data of the neural network model. In addition, the vehicle components of different structures include vehicle components of different manufacturers, product numbers, models, and the like from those before replacement.

The component information acquisition unit 53 detects replacement of a vehicle component by reading identification information (a manufacturing company name, a model number, a serial number, a manufacturing serial number, and the like) of the vehicle component, for example. The component information acquiring unit 53 may detect replacement of a vehicle component by detecting an output waveform, an operating voltage, and the like of the vehicle component. The operator may input the replacement of the vehicle component to an input device (HMI or the like) of the vehicle 3, and the component information acquisition unit 53 may detect the replacement of the vehicle component based on the input to the input device.

If it is determined in step S102 that the vehicle component has not been replaced, the present control routine is ended. On the other hand, if it is determined in step S102 that the vehicle component has been replaced, the control routine proceeds to step S103. In step S103, the component information acquisition unit 53 acquires identification information of the vehicle component.

Next, in step S104, the component information acquisition unit 53 sets the replacement flag F to 1.

Next, in step S105, the update unit 52 transmits the identification information of the vehicle component after replacement to the server 2 via the communication module 33, the wireless base station 6, and the communication network 5.

After step S105, the present control routine proceeds to step S106. On the other hand, if it is determined in step S101 that the replacement flag F is 1, the control routine skips step S102 to step S105 and proceeds to step S106.

In step S106, the update unit 52 determines whether or not a new neural network model is received from the server 2. If it is determined that no new neural network model has been received, the control routine is terminated. On the other hand, if it is determined that a new neural network model has been received, the control routine proceeds to step S107.

In step S107, the updating unit 52 applies the new neural network model to the vehicle 3. In other words, the updating unit 52 updates the neural network model used in the vehicle 3 to a new neural network model. That is, the information of the neural network model stored in the memory 42 or other storage device of the ECU40 is rewritten.

Next, in step S108, the update unit 52 sets the replacement flag F to 0. After step S108, the present control routine ends.

Fig. 6 is a flowchart showing a control routine of the model transmission process. The present control routine is repeatedly executed by the processor 24 of the server 2 at predetermined execution intervals.

First, in step S201, the processor 24 determines whether identification information of a vehicle component is received from the vehicle 3. When it is determined that the identification information of the vehicle component has not been received, the present control routine is ended. On the other hand, if it is determined that the identification information of the vehicle component is received, the control routine proceeds to step S202.

In step S202, the processor 24 determines a vehicle component after replacement based on the identification information of the vehicle component, and determines a neural network model corresponding to the vehicle component after replacement. Specifically, the processor 24 extracts a neural network model learned using a training data set corresponding to the vehicle component after replacement from among the plurality of neural network models stored in the storage device 22 of the server 2. In the training data set corresponding to the vehicle component after replacement, the output value of the vehicle component after replacement, the command value to be issued to the vehicle component after replacement, and the like are used as one of the actual measurement values of the input data.

Next, in step S203, the processor 24 transmits the new neural network model determined in step S202 to the vehicle 3. After step S203, the present control routine ends.

In step S105 of fig. 5, the update unit 52 may transmit the identification information of the vehicle component after the replacement and the identification information (the vehicle name, the model number, and the like) of the vehicle 3 to the server 2, and in step S203 of fig. 6, the processor 24 of the server 2 may transmit the neural network model corresponding to the identification information of the vehicle component after the replacement and the vehicle 3 to the vehicle 3 as a new neural network model. This makes it possible to apply a neural network model more suitable for the characteristics of the vehicle 3 to the vehicle 3, and further suppress a decrease in the estimation accuracy of the neural network model.

In this case, the identification information of the vehicle 3 is stored in advance in the memory 42 of the ECU40 or the like. In the server 2, a neural network model generated for each vehicle type, for example, a neural network model learned using a training data set created from actual measurement values of input data and output data acquired using an engine mount or the like prepared for each vehicle type is stored in advance in the storage device 22 of the server 2.

While the preferred embodiments of the present invention have been described above, the present invention is not limited to these embodiments, and various modifications and changes can be made within the scope of the claims. For example, the machine learning model used in the vehicle 3 may be a machine learning model other than a neural network, such as a random forest, a k-neighborhood method, or a support vector machine.
